column3: NASB follows the critical text; “listen to” is rendered “hear.”
“Out of the age” is rendered “Since the beginning of time”; NASB adds “a person.”
“Cast him out” is rendered “put him out.”
NASB follows the critical text with “the Son of Man” (Textus Receptus: “the Son of God”).
Close to the Greek. Some early manuscripts lack vv. 38–39a; NASB includes them.
NASB follows the critical text; the question expecting “no” is rendered “are we?”
